name: Migrate CiviCRM
description: Migrate source and destination plugins for the CiviCRM API v4.
project_description:
Migrate Source and Destination plugins for CiviCRM via CiviCRM's api4 - allows importing into and out of CiviCRM via Drupal Migrate.

 Features 
 Post-Installation 
 How does this module actually work once I install it? Should I go to a config page? Should I look for a new content type? Should I go and manage my text formats? Provide an overview of the configuration process and any other special considerations for the module.

 Additional Requirements 
 You will need migrate and CiviCRM installed on the site. As well as this you will need to write your own custom migration to manage the import/export.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 None

 Similar projects 
 Successor to civicrm_migrate for a D8+ install.

 Supporting this Module 
 Open to paid support and feature requests via fuzion.co.nz .
